summary: Demis Hassabis announces DiffusionGemma, a text-diffusion variant of the Gemma model family that runs 4x faster than other Gemma 4 models.

mechanisms.reason: A named technique (text diffusion) is stated to deliver a quantified speedup over standard Gemma 4 models, implying reduced compute per generated output.
mechanisms.quote: DiffusionGemma is lightning fast, 4x faster than other Gemma 4 models!

practices.reason: A team building latency-sensitive applications could evaluate the diffusion-based Gemma variant given its stated 4x speed advantage.
